notes.title: Limited Time Mizuchi Merchandise Preorder and Soundtrack Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Merchandise[/h1]

We have been slow and busy trying to get multiple things done, so our sincerest apologies for the delay in the news. We wanted to mention that the official Aikasa Collective store is open. If you missed out on the Kickstarter for Mizuchi physical merchandise before, this is your chance to order some of the limited edition items until [b]November 17th, 2021[/b]! Since the merchandise is a preorder run, we have no plans to produce any more merchandise in the future once we're out of stock. Feel free to check out our store: [url=http://aikasacollective.com/shop/]http://aikasacollective.com/shop/[/url]

[url=http://aikasacollective.com/shop/]http://aikasacollective.com/shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/fa13a9465fbe61b9f25b40fa5a5753404ec7afd4.png[/img][/url]
Some examples of our merch: Official Artbook (illustrations, sketches, commentary), keychains, and character stand. We have mostly Asia-character style goods. No physical CD or OST due to damage risks in the mail.


[h1]Mizuchi Soundtrack[/h1]

We are happy to announce we are offering the Mizuchi all-original soundtrack of 15 songs and 2 additional bonus tracks! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811570/Mizuchi__Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811570/Mizuchi__Soundtrack/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811570/Mizuchi__Soundtrack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/ef6b2b2a46f8f66708b0d130b06e165d85c959ce.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Localization News[/h1]

So.... nothing has changed in getting Chinese (simplified and traditional) out, but there have definitely been a few hiccups / glitches in getting it to work properly on the build. It's the next focus now that merchandise is just about to finish up, so thank you for your patience. We are also in discussion with a publisher, who is also offering a few other languages to localize, as well as translation company LQA check. So we'll see how things pan out. Otherwise, for time constraints, we may just go with our current translator for the Chinese PC Steam release first and update later if there are big text changes. We are absolutely sorry for the delay on this, but hope to provide you a quality translated game when ready.

Thank you for your time!

notes.title: Updated to Version 1.2
notes.notes: We have fixed all known typos, grammar and any other errors reported to and found by us. We have also updated the game with sound effects fixes, and a few additional new songs and variations. Next update we have planned is the Chinese version of the game (Simplified and Traditional). Translations are complete, but we need to fulfill merchandise requirements first as those are long overdue. Thank you for your patience! Latest version should have the achievements fixed too.

notes.title: Mizuchi Release - Compassionate Launch Discount
notes.notes:
This is a difficult time for everyone, and the team at Aikasa Collective wants to provide enjoyment to everyone during these tough times. So, with support from our backers, the team has decided to launch at 33% discount for our first week! Mizuchi is a story made with love, and we want it to be able to reach as many people as possible ^_^

Please help us spread the good word and the yuri love. We hope we can bring some joy to your days spent in shutdown!
